question: Will Reinhard ever fall in love with someone?
answer: Will there ever be a day when Reinhard learns to love someone? If you read the School IF, you might find out. I like Shoujo Manga types of stories, and Felt is going the Shoujo Manga route, so I don’t know how it’s going to end up. I think it isn’t weird for him to fall in love, but I am not planning to write anything about Reinhard’s romantic relationship.
